recommendation: Keep the no-change audit for FHIR-26921. If OO wants to revisit repeatable device choices or the remaining cardinality/comment tension, do that through FHIR-53307 or a successor rather than by re-opening the already-satisfied DeviceDefinition target request.
issue_request: FHIR-26921 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request raised against R4 and applied for R5. It asked that ObservationDefinition.device be able to point to DeviceDefinition as well as Device, with the resolution to add DeviceDefinition as a target resource of device.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied in commit 56b91f72c1e36104fa43f12c189891648867d5bd, which updated ObservationDefinition.device while applying the coupled ObservationDefinition tracker set. That commit changed the device definition text, added DeviceDefinition support, and paired this issue with FHIR-28097's repeating-cardinality change.
additional_context: ObservationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source no longer uses the original R5 Reference(Device|DeviceDefinition) shape; ObservationDefinition.device[x] is 0..1 with Reference(Device) and canonical(DeviceDefinition). That later representation is explained by FHIR-39389, which made DeviceDefinition a CanonicalResource and requested that references to DeviceDefinition use canonical rather than Reference. The current ObservationDefinition ballot note added by FHIR-53623 also describes the R6 change as updating ObservationDefinition.device for the canonical DeviceDefinition. The related FHIR-28097 cardinality question is already represented on the combined branch by a human-review audit commit and is entangled with non-final FHIR-53307.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source already permits ObservationDefinition.device to identify a DeviceDefinition, and changing it back to Reference(DeviceDefinition) would conflict with later canonical DeviceDefinition modeling now present in the current build.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published issue changed ObservationDefinition.device cardinality and was applied in the same 2021 source commit; it already has a human-review audit commit on the combined branch.
